title: After Bombay HC rap, FDA withdraws orders against Cipla, MCA eateries

With the court's direction, the FDA rescinded its suspension of the Mumbai Cricket Association restaurants and reinstated Cipla's drug sale licence. The court called on the FDA to practice due diligence in its enforcement strategies.

title: What does Tom Brady keep from every Super Bowl win? The answer is on his phone
description: Tom Brady has seven Super Bowl rings, but one of his most personal collections lives on his phone. The former NFL quarterback revealed that he created separate folders for his championship victories and saved congratulatory messages sent after each one. The habit has preserved a private record of a career that included 10 Super Bowl appearances and five Super Bowl MVP awards.

title: Haiti gang frees 13 women and children days after raid that killed at least 47 people
description: A gang in Haiti has freed thirteen hostages, including women and children, following a brutal assault. UNICEF played a crucial role in securing their release from a farming community. This incident in Kenscoff underscores the rampant violence impacting children across Haiti. The region has faced numerous fatalities and displacement due to gang activities, although mass abductions are less frequent and often yield unpredictable results for those abducted.

Police arrived and attempted to persuade her to step away from the railing. A passerby intervened and successfully pulled her away from the edge. The incident, stemming from a family dispute, was resolved safely.

Additionally, the preparation of bowler-friendly pitches for the World Test Championship and the impact of DRS technology on umpiring decisions, particularly LBWs, are significant factors. Statistics reveal a noticeable increase in matches concluding within a three-day timeframe.

Police registered a case against the youths for alleged abduction attempts.

title: Kuku Kohli prayer meet: Bollywood actors pay their last respects

Several film industry actors and actresses paid their last respects. Rajpal Yadav and Sunny Kaushal were among the notable attendees. The event honored the director known for films like 'Phool Aur Kaante'.

title: Neeraj Chopra’s injury battles: From elbow surgery to 2026 ankle ligament tear
description: Neeraj Chopra's pursuit of glory takes another hit as he is sidelined from the 2026 Asian Games due to an ankle ligament tear sustained in a recent event. This injury adds to his history of struggles, including a prolonged nine-month battle with a back ailment. Previously, he faced challenges with adductor issues that also clouded his 2024 season, leading to ongoing interruptions in his remarkable athletic journey.

title: Faf shares heartfelt Nepal flood message: ‘Devastating to see what has happened’

Nepal's Finance Minister acknowledged India's invaluable support in reconstruction efforts as rescue operations persist amidst widespread devastation.

title: GST Council meet on Sept 12: Easier registration, automated cancellations in focus
description: On September 12, the GST Council will convene to streamline the business registration process, focusing significantly on companies that exceed Rs 2.5 lakh in monthly tax credits. The agenda also includes enhancing automation and revising GST registration cancellation procedures. This meeting comes in the wake of comprehensive GST rate adjustments that took effect in September 2025, alongside the implementation of a simplified scheme for small enterprises starting November 1.

Alcaraz aims to regain his top form and confidence following his wrist recovery.  Other top players like Jannik Sinner and Novak Djokovic are also competing.  The tennis world watches Alcaraz's comeback with keen interest and anticipation.

title: He chose cricket over Olympic gold with Dhyan Chand: MJ Gopalan played just 1 Test
description: MJ Gopalan found himself at a crossroads in 1936, forced to choose between the promise of Olympic hockey and a cricket tour. He chose cricket, which meant missing out on the Olympic gold as India's hockey squad achieved greatness. Though his first-class statistics were impressive, Gopalan's international experience was limited to a single Test appearance.

title: ‘Casteist slur, humiliation’: TN teacher booked after dalit teen dies by suicide
description: A tragic incident has unfolded as a teacher faces abetment charges following the suicide of a Dalit student. Reports suggest that the girl endured humiliation and was subjected to a casteist slur by the headmistress. In response, relatives have taken to the streets, demanding stricter action against the school official. The police are now investigating further, having amended the case to include these serious allegations.

title: 22 girls accuse school helper of molestation at Thane tribal school, arrested
description: A school helper faces new molestation allegations from twenty-two minor girls. He was previously jailed for a similar offense and released on bail. Police are investigating how he secured employment after his earlier arrest. The accused allegedly took advantage of girls' movements within the school. Authorities have registered a case and arrested the suspect.

title: ‘ISI used Indian SIM cards to target India': Suspected Pak spy held in Rajasthan
description: The Sri Ganganagar Police have reportedly detained a man suspected of acting as a spy for Pakistan, engaged in anti-national operations. This individual is accused of supplying Indian SIM cards to handlers of the ISI, which facilitated the opening of WhatsApp accounts for illicit communications. Authorities fear that this spy network could have collected crucial information about India's defense. Additionally, the suspect faces serious charges related to extensive narcotics trafficking.

title: Xi axes Galwan general: Zhao Zongqi removed from China's top advisory body
Minnesota removed common carp; lake clarity rose nearly 600% afterward
description: Pickerel Lake, Minnesota, has battled significant water quality and algal bloom problems for decades, primarily due to invasive common carp taking over the shallow waters. After their removal in 2009, the lake underwent a remarkable ecological revival, with water clarity significantly improving and native aquatic plants flourishing once more. This successful restoration highlights the pivotal role of addressing invasive species in revitalizing ecosystems.

title: Himachal scheme that offers Rs 1.5 lakh assistance for house construction
description: In Himachal Pradesh, eligible residents can access financial support for building homes under the Swaran Jayanti Ashray Yojana. This initiative provides a grant of Rs 1,50,000 to help establish new residences. To qualify, applicants must be permanent residents belonging to SC, ST, or OBC categories, without any house ownership, and must adhere to specified income limits. Documentation is required for the offline application process.

title: Fuel paradox: Russia has oil, so why is it importing petrol from India?
description: Russian petrol stations are rationing fuel due to Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries.  These strikes have disrupted domestic fuel supplies, causing shortages across the nation.  Russia is now importing finished petrol from countries like India to meet demand.  This unusual trade flow highlights the difference between crude production and refining capacity.  The ongoing refinery damage strains Russia's energy system supporting its economy.

title: H-1B workers' 60-day grace period may end: What happens next
description: The US Department of Homeland Security is considering a proposal that may eliminate the 60-day grace period for foreign workers, particularly affecting H-1B visa holders and countless Indian professionals. This grace period currently allows individuals to seek new jobs or modify their status before needing to leave the US. Without it in place, workers may face immediate departure following job loss, with final details pending further evaluation.

title: Samay Raina's India's Got Latent stirs row again after crass 'Kashmir, Bihar' banter
description: Comedian Samay Raina's recent show has drawn criticism for alleged remarks about certain communities. BJP MLA Ram Kadam condemned these statements, calling them publicity stunts. During the episode, Raina also made a joke about Archana Puran Singh's vlogging. Archana responded sharply, stating that abusing is a talent. The show's clips are currently circulating widely on social media platforms.

title: Jamie Dimon says it is ‘frustrating’ to hear America is behind in defence tech
description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon voiced frustration regarding US defense technology perceptions.  The bank launched a $1.5 trillion Security and Resiliency Initiative for national security industries.  This program now includes Canada, Europe, and the United Kingdom.  The initiative supports aerospace, defense, manufacturing, energy, and health tech sectors.  The bank is investing significant capital and personnel into this critical effort.

title: 'It is untouchability': Rahul attacks BJP, RSS for 'suddhikaran' after Kharge rally
Rebuilding after devastating floods may cost Nepal nearly 10% of its economy
description: Nepal's finance minister estimates flood reconstruction costs between four and five billion dollars.  This devastating flood killed over 600 people and left thousands missing.  The disaster destroyed towns, bridges, roads, and damaged hydropower stations significantly.  Search and rescue operations continue despite disruptions from bad weather conditions.  India has provided substantial relief materials to the affected regions.

title: A Pocso case. A man in coma. A murdered model: Delhi gym trainer's trail of violence
description: In a chilling revelation, Mohammad Imran, charged in the murder of Muskan, carries a record of alarming criminal behavior. He faced a POCSO allegation in 2018 involving the harassment of a young minor and was later implicated in an assault case that rendered the victim comatose in 2021. Muskan had voiced concerns about harassment at home prior to her death.

title: 'Grateful for special gesture': PM Modi thanks Uzbek prez for warm welcome
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi began a four-day visit to Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic. He will hold bilateral talks with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent. Modi will then attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit in Bishkek. This visit aims to strengthen India's strategic partnerships in Central Asia. The summit will bring together leaders from ten member nations.

title: Houston lawyer buys $15.5M mansion to demolish it for a garden
description: In River Oaks, Houston lawyer Tony Buzbee has bought a mansion primarily for property expansion. Teaming up with Habitat for Humanity, he aims to salvage valuable construction materials, which will provide substantial support—millions of pounds worth—for affordable housing projects. The planned demolition will allow for the development of a larger private garden estate while enhancing his family's legacy through philanthropic efforts.
